_comment: One entry per mos-geo-* skill. Adding a skill to the pack means adding it here and re-running build_template.py; the Checklist tab is generated from this list in this order.

skills.what_it_does: 360° brand intelligence report plus an AI Visibility Scorecard: does ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews know, find, cite and recommend the brand.

AI Info Page: an official, sourced fact sheet for ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini (basic info, background, services, clients, methods, advantages, guidance for AI), with one schema file and a developer handover.
skills.needs: Client website URL (uses Brand Truth Review corrections when present)

skills.what_it_does: Client-ready LLM share buttons package: brief, code reference and an in-brand demo of 'ask ChatGPT / Claude / Perplexity about this page' buttons.

Internal link audit (true contextual links vs template noise, orphans, deep pages, links to redirects and errors, anchor conflicts) plus reviewable contextual link recommendations: target, sentence and verbatim anchor, judged by TypeSafe Jev.
skills.feeds_tab: None yet (audit and recommendations live in the run folder)
skills.needs: Screaming Frog Internal HTML + All Inlinks exports and stored HTML (GSC columns optional); TypeSafe API key for judge/place

skills.what_it_does: For 1 to 500+ pages, finds the searches AI engines actually run (query fan-out) for the prompts each page should win, measures whether the page is cited today, and produces a per-page fix list (add exact string, add section, earn retrieval, skip unwinnable vendor searches) ranked by stability.
